newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: KTM says off to good start in H2.
newsitem.headline: KTM says off to good start in H2.

text.p: Austrian motorcycle maker KTM said on Monday it expected its full-year turnover to be double the first half figure of 615 million schillings and pre-tax profit margins to widen from 9.3 percent.

"The second half began in a very positive way with turnover of 134 million schillings in March and 136 million in April, so we expect the first half turnover to double for the full year," a statement said. KTM's financial year ends on August 31.
Last year turnover exceeded one billion schillings for the first time in the company's history and pre-tax profit reached 102 million.

The company predicted pre-tax profit margins would exceed the first half's 9.3 percent due to strong sales of "hard endurance" bikes that perform as well off-piste as they do on tarmac and street bikes .
KTM said it expected to pay a dividend for the full year for the first time on the basis of the estimated results.
The company plans to invest some 55 million schillings during the rest of the year, after 22.2 million in the first half.
At 1030 GMT KTM shares were up eight schillings at 780 in an overall buoyant Vienna market.
